title: Viva La Vida Or Death And All His Friends
notes: Initially released in early 2008 as a ten track album, later re-issued in late 2008 as a special edition album, including Viva La Vida Or Death And All His Friends and the [url=https://www.discogs.com/master/26622]Prospekt's March EP, also sold separately[/url] for those who had initially purchased the album when it was originally released).
